tasks.title: Fence the first destructive publication write
tasks.goal: Move readiness and authority checks ahead of every delete/tag/release mutation.
steps: Identify the first remote mutation in each prepare/apply route and trace all callers.
Refactor routes to consume an immutable ready plan plus authority result; reobserve expected remote IDs/generation immediately before first write.
Retain previous asset/metadata recovery material before mutation; report changed preconditions without rebuilding/reapproving implicitly.
positive_cases: Exact ready authorized subject reaches the writer once.
Plan-only and failed preflight preserve an existing release unchanged.
negative_cases: Missing target bundle, changed smoke policy, stale approval or remote generation refuses before deletion.
No caller may bypass the fence through a helper or legacy command route.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: xtask target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p xtask <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-publish target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-publish <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- facts check --exhaustive only when actual facts/adoption/reference/extraction or closure-contract impact requires exhaustive validation. Otherwise bind affected claim/source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
cargo fmt --all -- --check
git diff --check
acceptance: Fault-instrumented writer receives zero calls on every preflight refusal.
All prepare/apply entrypoints consume the same fence.
tasks.safe_stop: Preflight and writer ordering are proven with fake remote state; no live release changed.
tasks.commit_subject: fix(publish): validate readiness before destructive writes
notes: Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Recover interrupted remote publication prefixes
tasks.goal: Retain truthful per-effect state and recovery for an interrupted admitted publication.
steps: Record each remote effect and retained before-state through the M-16 operation identity and existing publication records.
Implement inspect/recover for interrupted upload/replacement/finalization; compare actual remote IDs/generation before each continuation or restoration.
Represent committed, pending and unknown effects; use retained assets only under current recovery authority, with no blanket multi-remote atomicity claim.
positive_cases: An interrupted isolated publication resumes its exact remaining effect set.
Supported restoration reproduces the retained old subject/assets.
negative_cases: Foreign remote mutation, missing backup and ambiguous third state produce recovery-required.
Response loss cannot create a second publication or overwrite an unrelated release.
